notes.title: THANK YOU FOR YOUR INTEREST IN THE GAME.
notes.notes: The interest shown in the game is really high. First of all, I would like to thank you for this. This is our first professional game as a company and we want to improve upon it. We have seen/read many good reviews and videos about the game both on Steam and on the web. I thank everyone for this. Keep playing Jinni Haunted House!
